Ceremony Timeline

Two sacred spaces, one celebration. Ekessh relatives will gather at the Ekessh Mandapam, and Keertanaa relatives will gather at the Keertanaa Mandapam. The rituals flow across both venues, and the union is completed at the Keertanaa Mandapam.

May 28, 2026
6:00 PM
Reception, Blessings & Shared Rituals
As evening lamps are lit, the reception begins and the families start the first set of auspicious rituals. The ceremonies are shared between both mandapams, like two streams joining the same river.
Ekessh Mandapam
Agarwal Bhavan Gathering for Ekessh relatives & evening rituals Keertanaa Mandapam
Aaru Nadu Arangam Gathering for Keertanaa relatives & evening rituals
May 29, 2026
Early Morning
Kasi Yatra · The Sacred Journey
Ekessh begins the Kasi Yatra, a symbolic walk of purpose and inner resolve, setting out from the Ekessh side. The procession moves towards the Keertanaa Mandapam as families gather in devotion and joy.
May 29, 2026
6:00 AM – 7:25 AM
The Promise · Wedding at the Keertanaa Mandapam
At the entrance of the Keertanaa Mandapam, Keertanaa's father invites Ekessh to step into married life with his daughter. Ekessh agrees, and the marriage is solemnized during the auspicious Muhurtham.

A Love Story Written in the Stars

Ekessh, an AI Engineer who calls Waterloo, Canada home, and Keertanaa, a dedicated physiotherapist rooted in Madurai — two souls shaped by their families' love and their own ambitions, found in each other a perfect balance of warmth, purpose, and joy. Their families, united by tradition and affection, are overjoyed to invite you to witness and bless this beautiful new beginning.

With love, Ekessh & Keertanaa
